turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is Jordan from the customer accounts team at Brightline Energy. Is that Mrs Clarke?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thanks. I'm calling because your account is two months overdue, with a balance of two hundred and eighteen pounds. I know that's not nice to hear.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh dear. Things have been a bit tight this year. Are you going to cut me off?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, nothing like that. We aren't taking any legal action, and there's no deadline today. I just wanted to make sure you knew about the support we offer.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Do you need my card details to sort it out?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, I don't want you to give me any payment details on this call. You can pay in your online account, or ring the number printed on your bill.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang on. Could I spread it over a few months?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Of course. We can set up a payment plan for you, and there's also a hardship fund that you might be able to apply for.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That would really help. What do I need to do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Have a look at the letter we've sent you, then call us whenever suits you, and one of the team will talk it through. Take your time.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thank you. I'll do that this week.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You're welcome, Mrs Clarke. Bye for now.
